description: Crypto.Net for VS Code: wallets, balances, address checks, unit hovers, contract client generation, templates and local nodes for Bitcoin, Ethereum/EVM, Solana, Polkadot and Cosmos. Built by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
config.cliPath: Path or name of the cnet CLI (dotnet tool install -g Crypto.Net.Cli).
config.hover: Show unit conversions and address checks when hovering C# code.
config.diagnostics: Warn about EVM addresses whose EIP-55 checksum is wrong.
